sms.pump: Pump coach: run the pump {duration} today ({litres} L). Reply DONE when finished.
sms.no_pump: Pump coach: no pumping needed today. The soil still holds enough water.
sms.no_pump_full: Pump coach: no pumping needed today. The root zone is full.
sms.ask_rain_since: Pump coach: how much rain since {since}? Reply RAIN and the mm in your tin, e.g. RAIN 5, or RAIN 0.
sms.ask_moisture_check: Pump coach: dig soil at root depth and squeeze. Reply DRY, DAMP or WET.
sms.ask_second_check: Pump coach: the soil check and the water count disagree. Check once more: reply DRY, DAMP or WET.
sms.escalate_extension_officer: Pump coach: checks keep disagreeing. Please ask your extension officer to see the plot.
sms.needs_agent: Pump coach: setup is not finished. Please see your pump dealer or extension officer.
sms.help: Pump coach: TODAY, RAIN 5, DONE, DONE 90 (minutes run), SKIP, DRY/DAMP/WET, SOAKED, SWAHILI.
sms.unknown: Sorry, not understood. Reply HELP for the words.
sms.not_registered: This number is not registered. Please see your pump dealer or extension officer.
